description: The same Instance in Env A (left) and Env B (right): pg_stat_statements per query mask (pg_stmt_mask, top 200), masks of one env only and mean time changes. Click query_mask_md5 for the statement detail.

panels.description: share_pct = share of the env total exec time: the load differs between envs, compare the shares. Per query mask (IN-lists / VALUES collapsed), summed over users, increase over the range.

targets.query: SELECT sum("total_ms") AS "total_ms", sum("calls") AS "calls", sum("total_ms") / sum("calls") AS "mean_ms", sum("rows") AS "rows", last("query_mask") AS "query_mask" FROM (SELECT spread("total_exec_time") AS "total_ms", spread("calls") AS "calls", spread("rows") AS "rows", last("query_mask_short") AS "query_mask" FROM "$rp"."pg_stmt_mask" WHERE $timeFilter AND env = '$env_a' AND db_instance =~ /^$db_instance$/ AND datname =~ /^$datname$/ GROUP BY "env", "datname", "usename", "query_mask_md5") GROUP BY "env", "datname", "query_mask_md5"
